Name: Way Too Many Coop Options
Author: Nuztalgia
Description:
Someone on the SDV Discord wanted a simple mod to make the Big Coop and Deluxe Coop look like the classic Coop, because they thought the simplest one had the cutest and most charming style. I agreed and said I could help them out, but then I went a little crazy with Content Patcher... so here's a coop mod with a ton of options that no one asked for! ?

This mod is opted in to the Donation Points program, and 100% of rewards earned from downloads will go towards the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/modrewards#/store/item/103]Ukraine Relief Effort[/url]. ??


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/469906545480826890/957083165032337518/installation.png[/img]

[b]1)[/b] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]the latest version of SMAPI[/url], or follow [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Android#Install]these instructions[/url] if you're on Android.
[b]2)[/b] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files#file-container-main-files]the latest version of Content Patcher[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files#file-container-optional-files]the 1.19.0 version[/url] if you're on Android.
[b]3)[/b] Download either the main file [b][u]OR[/u][/b] the Android version of this mod from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11353?tab=files]Files[/url] tab, and unzip it into your [b]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/b] folder.
[b]4)[/b] Run the game with SMAPI to generate a [b]"config.json"[/b] file in the mod folder. You [i]can[/i] edit this file directly with a text editor, but...
[b]5)[/b] I recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], so you can edit your config settings while in-game. It has a version that works on Android too!


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/469906545480826890/957083164126347294/configuration.png[/img]

This mod allows you to completely enable/disable customization for each "level" of coop. For example, if you have the [b]"Customize Big Coops"[/b] option enabled, then your big coops will look like colorful basic coops and you'll be able to change the individual colors and styles by using the config options labeled [b]"Big Coop"[/b]. But if you like the style of the vanilla Big Coop and don't want this mod to make your big coops look basic - [i]psshhh[/i] - then you can simply disable the [b]"Customize Big Coops"[/b] option to fully restore their regular appearance.

There are [u][b]three[/b][/u] options that apply universally to all coop levels that have their "Customize ____ Coops" setting enabled. These options are listed at the very top of the config menu, and are as follows:

[size=2][b]1) Flower Style:[/b]  [b][color=#f39dac]D[/color][color=#f6ac86]y[/color][color=#fabb61]n[/color][color=#fdca3b]a[/color][color=#eea83d]m[/color][color=#df8640]i[/color][color=#d06442]c[/color][/b] / [b][color=#f39dac]Always Spring[/color][/b] / [b][color=#fdca3b]Always Summer[/color][/b] / [b][color=#d06442]Always Fall[/color][/b]
[color=#aaaaaa]Select "Dynamic" if you want the flower and vine colors to change with the in-game seasons. Select one of the other choices if you prefer the colors for a specific season. Flowers will only be drawn on coops that have their [b]"Flowers"[/b] option enabled.[/color]

[b]2) Recolored Hay:[/b]  [b][color=#e7a13c]Enabled[/color][/b] / [b][color=#c78100]Disabled[/color][/b]
[color=#aaaaaa]Enable this option if you want the hay in the coop outdoors area to be a bit lighter and softer-looking.[/color]

[b]3) Winter Snow:[/b]  [b][color=#97e0ff]Enabled[/color][/b] / [b][color=#e7a13c]Disabled[/color][/b]
[color=#aaaaaa]Enable this option if you want there to be snow (instead of hay) in the coop outdoors area during winter.[/color][/size]


Additionally, there are [u][b]seven[/b][/u] options that can be set separately for each coop level. These are listed three times each (once per coop level) in the config menu:

[size=2][b]1) Wall Color:[/b]  [b][color=#9b6138]Brown[/color][/b] / [b][color=#432926]Dark[/color][/b] / [b][color=#587a1e]Green[/color][/b] / [b][color=#ffbb7d]Peach[/color][/b] / [b][color=#eadfaa]White[/color][/b]

[b]2) Wall Repairs:[/b]  [b][color=#ffb676]E[/color][color=#fbaf72]n[/color][color=#f8a86e]a[/color][color=#f4a16a]b[/color][color=#f09a65]l[/color][color=#ed9361]e[/color][color=#e98C5d]d[/color][/b] / [b][color=#ffb676]D[/color][color=#e49369]i[/color][color=#ca705c]s[/color][color=#f6aa72]a[/color][color=#d37c60]b[/color][color=#ffb676]l[/color][color=#ca705c]e[/color][color=#ed9f6d]d[/color][/b]

[b]3) Trim Style:[/b]  [b][color=#5b2522]Burgundy[/color][/b] / [b][color=#432926]Ebony[/color][/b] / [b][color=#d3893b]Oak[/color][/b] / [b][color=#eadfaa]White[/color][/b]

[b]4) Roof Color:[/b]  [b][color=#3882b9]Blue[/color][/b] / [b][color=#9b6138]Brown[/color][/b] / [b][color=#432926]Dark[/color][/b] / [b][color=#d24e35]Red[/color][/b] / [b][color=#eadfaa]White[/color][/b]

[b]5) Roof Decor:[/b]  [b][color=#7c7c7c]None[/color][/b] / [b][color=#9b6138]Brown Chicken[/color][/b] / [b][color=#eadfaa]White Chicken[/color][/b]

[b]6) Fence Style:[/b]  [b][color=#5b2522]Burgundy[/color][/b] / [b][color=#432926]Ebony[/color][/b] / [b][color=#d3893b]Oak[/color][/b] / [b][color=#eadfaa]White[/color][/b]

[b]7) Flowers:[/b]  [b][color=#f39dac]E[/color][color=#f6ac86]n[/color][color=#fabb61]a[/color][color=#fdca3b]b[/color][color=#eea83d]l[/color][color=#df8640]e[/color][color=#d06442]d[/color][/b] / [b][color=#7c7c7c]Disabled[/color][/b][/size]


If my calculations are correct, then this mod enables a total of [u][b]76,800[/b][/u] possible unique coop appearances! ? Image submissions on this page are open to users, so please feel free to submit screenshots of your colorful coops. I'd love to see what you come up with!

[size=2][color=#aaaaaa][b]Disclaimer #1:[/b] I'm terrible at math, so that probably isn't actually the right number. Feel free to correct me.
[b]Disclaimer #2:[/b] Some of the possible color combinations [s]probably[/s] definitely look atrocious. Try to avoid those![/color][/size]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/469906545480826890/957083163367202877/compatibility.png[/img]

❤ Works on Windows, Linux, Mac, and Android.
❤ Works with other farm building reskin mods. Only the coops that you enable in this mod's config will overwrite other mods' changes.
❤ Speaking of other reskin mods... Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196]Lumisteria's[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's[/url] for a similar vanilla feel! (They're also [i]much[/i] more experienced artists than I am. ?)
❤ As far as I know, this mod has no incompatibilities with any other mods. But if you run into any issues, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11353?tab=posts]leave a comment[/url] and I can try to help you out!
[b] [/b]
